statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.description: The character is poisoned. A poison counter accumulates with each application and drains HP each game tick until the counter reaches zero.
statuses.notes: The poison counter is the duration value. Stacking adds to the counter. Each tick of damage decrements the counter by 1.

statuses.name: Blinded
statuses.description: The character cannot see. All non-adjacent tiles are invisible, and the character cannot read scrolls.

statuses.name: Confused
statuses.description: The character moves and attacks in random directions. Spell casting fails. Cannot read scrolls.
statuses.notes: When reapplied, keep the stronger remaining duration.

statuses.name: Afraid
statuses.description: The character flees from monsters and cannot perform melee attacks.

statuses.name: Paralyzed
statuses.description: The character cannot move or act. Any monster attack automatically hits.

statuses.name: Hallucinating
statuses.description: The character sees random monsters and features instead of actual ones.

statuses.name: Sleeping
statuses.description: The character or monster is asleep and cannot act until disturbed.
statuses.notes: Applied to monsters via the SLEEP activation. Not normally inflicted on the player directly.

statuses.name: Heroism
statuses.description: The character gains +12 to hit and becomes immune to fear. Grants a temporary +10 MaxHP bonus while active;

statuses.name: Berserk Strength
statuses.description: The character gains +24 to hit, +24 to damage, and immunity to fear, but suffers -10 AC. Grants a temporary +30 MaxHP bonus while active; the bonus is removed when the status expires.
statuses.notes: MAngband set_shero(). The hp_player(30) call in the spell is modeled as a temporary MaxHP bonus on the status, not a permanent heal.

statuses.name: Blessed
statuses.description: The character gains +5 to hit, +5 AC, and priests may use non-blunt blessed weapons without penalty.

statuses.name: Protected from Evil
statuses.description: Evil creatures suffer a saving-throw penalty when attacking the character. Duration scales with player level.
statuses.notes: MAngband: set_protevil(p_ptr->lev * 3 + randint(25)). Canonical duration: 1d25 + 3 * player_level.

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.description: The character gains an extra movement and attack each turn (speed +10 effectively).
statuses.notes: Duration varies by source: HASTE applies 10+1d10, HASTE1/HASTE2 apply 20+1d20. The apply_status effect overrides default_duration.

statuses.name: Elemental Oppose Bundle
statuses.description: Compatibility status representing a timed multi-element oppose bundle from legacy content.
statuses.notes: Use explicit oppose_* statuses in new content; retained for parity compatibility.

statuses.name: Slowed
statuses.description: The character moves and acts more slowly (-10 to speed).

statuses.name: Oppose Fire (Legacy Alias)
statuses.description: Compatibility timed oppose-fire status retained for legacy content references.

statuses.name: Oppose Cold (Legacy Alias)
statuses.description: Compatibility timed oppose-cold status retained for legacy content references.

statuses.name: See Invisible
statuses.description: The character can see invisible creatures.

statuses.name: Infravision (Extended)
statuses.description: The character's infravision range is extended by 50 feet.

statuses.name: Oppose Acid
statuses.description: Timed oppose state that mitigates acid damage as a temporary channel.

statuses.name: Oppose Lightning
statuses.description: Timed oppose state that mitigates lightning damage as a temporary channel.

statuses.name: Oppose Fire
statuses.description: Timed oppose state that mitigates fire damage as a temporary channel.

statuses.name: Oppose Cold
statuses.description: Timed oppose state that mitigates cold damage as a temporary channel.

statuses.name: Oppose Poison
statuses.description: Timed oppose state that mitigates poison effects as a temporary channel.

statuses.name: Mystic Shield
statuses.description: A mystic shield forms around the character's body, granting +50 AC for the duration. The counter is a numeric timer that decays each game tick.
statuses.notes: set_shield() stores the timer in p_ptr->shield. While non-zero: p_ptr->to_a += 50. Duration from SPELL_SHIELD is randint1(20)+30.

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.description: The character is stunned. A numeric severity counter controls effect tier: stun (1-50) applies -5 to-hit and -5 to-dam; heavy stun (51-99) applies -20 to-hit and -20 to-dam; knocked out (100+) drains energy to zero each turn (full paralysis). The counter decays per tick based on CON.
statuses.notes: Threshold behavior: stun >= 100 causes p_ptr->energy = 0 each game turn (equivalent to paralysis). Counter stored in p_ptr->stun.

statuses.name: Cut
statuses.description: The character is bleeding. A numeric severity counter controls effect tier across 7 levels (graze through mortal wound). HP drains each game tick proportional to severity; the counter decays per tick based on CON. Mortal wounds (counter > 1000) do not decay and are lethal without treatment.
statuses.notes: Seven severity tiers in p_ptr->cut: graze (1-10), light (11-25), bad (26-50), nasty (51-100), severe (101-200), deep gash (201-1000), mortal (1001+). Mortal wounds do not self-heal.
